## Gene ontology (GO) based enrichment analysis - Loop over all comparisons
Here we repeat the GO analysis in a loop that processes all comparisons.
```{r Functional Analysis: GO – Loop}

# Tissue-specific universe
backgrounds <- list(
  B = brain_bg$probes,
  G = gonad_bg$probes,
  L = liver_bg$probes
  )

# Create a reusable topGO function
run_topGO_pipeline <- function(table, comp_name, tissue_name, backgrounds, db_object) {

  cat("Running topGO for:", comp_name, "in", tissue_name, "\n")
  
  # To store skip messages from all IF sections
  skip_messages <- c()

  # 1. Tissue-specific universe
  gene_IDs <- backgrounds[[tissue_name]]
  
  # 2. Extract probe → GO term mapping 
  gene2go <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    db_object,
    keys = gene_IDs,
    keytype = "PROBEID",
    columns = "GO"
  )

  # Remove NAs and split into 2 columns
  gene2go <- gene2go[!is.na(gene2go$GO), ]
  gene2GO_list <- split(gene2go$GO, gene2go$PROBEID)
  
  # Store probes, from the tissue-specific universe, with GO annotation
  mapped_probes <- unique(gene2go$PROBEID)
  
  # 3. Extract probe → gene mapping
  probe2gene_table <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    db_object,
    keys = all_probeIDs,
    keytype = "PROBEID",
    columns = "SYMBOL"
  )
  
  # Remove probes without gene names
  probe2gene_table <- probe2gene_table[!is.na(probe2gene_table$SYMBOL), ]
  
  # Convert it into a mapping vector
  probe2gene <- setNames(probe2gene_table$SYMBOL, probe2gene_table$PROBEID)
  
  
  # 4. Define UP / DOWN w/logFC and FDR parameters
  UP_genes   <- rownames(table)[table$logFC >=  2 & table$adj.P.Val < 0.05]
  DOWN_genes <- rownames(table)[table$logFC <= -2 & table$adj.P.Val < 0.05]
  
  # Store number of DEGs for CSV
  n_UP_DEG   <- length(UP_genes)
  n_DOWN_DEG <- length(DOWN_genes)
  
  ## 4.1. Build summary table
  summary_table_GO <- data.frame(
    Comparison = comp_name,
    Tissue = tissue_name,
    Direction = c("UP","DOWN"),
    
    Universe_size = length(gene_IDs),
  
    DEGs = c(n_UP_DEG, n_DOWN_DEG),
    
    Probes_entering_GOmapping = 0,
    Probes_entering_GOenrich = 0,
    GO_terms = 0,
    SYMBOLs_from_GOterms = 0,
    GO_signif = 0,
    SYMBOLs_from_signifGO = 0
    )


  # Safety check 1 — No DEGs
  if(length(UP_genes) == 0){
    message("No UP DEGs detected")
    skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "No UP DEGs")
    }

  if(length(DOWN_genes) == 0){
    message("No DOWN DEGs detected")
    skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "No DOWN DEGs")
    }

  if(length(UP_genes) == 0 & length(DOWN_genes) == 0){
    message("Skipping GO analysis: no DEGs")

  return(list(
    result = NULL,
    summary = summary_table_GO,
    skipped = TRUE,
    reason = paste(skip_messages, collapse = " | ")
  ))
    }

  
  # 5. Filter to keep only probes that are actually on the DB
  valid_probes <- keys(db_object, "PROBEID")

  # Intersect objects to keep only valid probes
  UP_genes <- intersect(UP_genes, valid_probes)
  DOWN_genes <- intersect(DOWN_genes, valid_probes)

  # Capture valid probes to save later in CSV
  n_UP_valid   <- length(UP_genes)
  n_DOWN_valid <- length(DOWN_genes)

  # Update CSV with valid probes
  summary_table_GO$Probes_entering_GOmapping[summary_table_GO$Direction=="UP"] <- n_UP_valid
  summary_table_GO$Probes_entering_GOmapping[summary_table_GO$Direction=="DOWN"] <- n_DOWN_valid
  
  # Safety check 2 — No valid probes in DB
  if(length(UP_genes) == 0){
    message("No UP genes with valid PROBEID")
    skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "No UP valid PROBEID")
    }

  if(length(DOWN_genes) == 0){
    message("No DOWN genes with valid PROBEID")
    skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "No DOWN valid PROBEID")
    }

  if(length(UP_genes) == 0 & length(DOWN_genes) == 0){
    message("Skipping GO analysis: no valid PROBEIDs")

  return(list(
    result = NULL,
    summary = summary_table_GO,
    skipped = TRUE,
    reason = paste(skip_messages, collapse = " | ")
  ))
  }
  
  # 6. Intersect to keep only DE-valid probes with GO annotation
  UP_genes <- intersect(UP_genes, mapped_probes)
  DOWN_genes <- intersect(DOWN_genes, mapped_probes)

  # Capture valid probes with GO annotation, to save later in CSV
  n_UP_GO   <- length(UP_genes)
  n_DOWN_GO <- length(DOWN_genes)

  # Update CSV with valid probes with GO annotation
  summary_table_GO$Probes_entering_GOenrich[summary_table_GO$Direction=="UP"] <- n_UP_GO
  summary_table_GO$Probes_entering_GOenrich[summary_table_GO$Direction=="DOWN"] <- n_DOWN_GO
  
  # Safety check 3 — No DEGs with GO terms
  if(length(UP_genes) == 0){
   message("No UP DEGs with GO annotations")
   skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "No UP DEGs with GO annot.")
    }

  if(length(DOWN_genes) == 0){
    message("No DOWN DEGs detected")
    skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "No DOWN DEGs with GO annot.")
    }

  if(length(UP_genes) == 0 & length(DOWN_genes) == 0){
    message("Skipping GO analysis: no DEGs with GO annotations")

  return(list(
    result = NULL,
    summary = summary_table_GO,
    skipped = TRUE,
    reason = paste(skip_messages, collapse = " | ")
    ))
  }


  # 7. Run topGO
  results_list <- list()
  
  # For UP genes
  # Binary vectors for UP genes (1 = DE, 0 = not DE) and convert to factor
  all_genes_up <- factor(
    as.integer(gene_IDs %in% UP_genes),
    levels = c(0,1)
  )
  
  # Name UP genes vector with Affy transcript cluster IDs
  names(all_genes_up) <- gene_IDs

  # Create topGO object for UP genes
  topGO_up <- NULL
  if(length(UP_genes) > 0){
  topGO_up <- new("topGOdata",
                  ontology="BP",
                  allGenes=all_genes_up,
                  gene2GO=gene2GO_list,
                  nodeSize=10, #Min.num. of annotated genes to test a GOterm.
                  annot=annFUN.gene2GO)
}

  # Run elim Fisher for UP genes
  res_uptopGO_elim <- NULL
  if(!is.null(topGO_up)){
  res_uptopGO_elim <-
    runTest(topGO_up, algorithm = "elim", statistic = "Fisher")
  }
  
  # Extract as data frame for UP genes
  res_uptopGO <- NULL
  if(!is.null(res_uptopGO_elim)){
  res_uptopGO <- GenTable(topGO_up, Fisher.elim = res_uptopGO_elim,
        orderBy = "Fisher.elim", topNodes = length(score(res_uptopGO_elim)))
  }

  # Convert p-values to numeric for UP genes
  if(!is.null(res_uptopGO)){
  res_uptopGO$Fisher.elim <- as.numeric(res_uptopGO$Fisher.elim)
  }
  
  # Remove NAs in Fisher.elim column
  if(!is.null(res_uptopGO)){
  res_uptopGO <- res_uptopGO[!is.na(res_uptopGO$Fisher.elim), ]
  }
  
  # Condition in case topGO was performed but no terms found
  if(is.null(res_uptopGO) || nrow(as.data.frame(res_uptopGO)) == 0){
      message("No topGO enrichment for UP in ", comp_name)
      skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "UP: No enrichment")
    } else {
      res_uptopGO$Direction <- "UP"   # Add direction for UP genes
      results_list[["UP"]] <- res_uptopGO   # Store results as UP genes
    }

  
  # For DOWN genes
  # Binary vectors for DOWN genes (1 = DE, 0 = not DE) and convert to factor
  all_genes_down <- factor(
    as.integer(gene_IDs %in% DOWN_genes),
    levels = c(0,1)
  )
  
  # Name DOWN genes vector with Affy transcript cluster IDs
  names(all_genes_down) <- gene_IDs

  # Create topGO object for DOWN genes
  topGO_down <- NULL
  if(length(DOWN_genes) > 0){
  topGO_down <- new("topGOdata",
                    ontology="BP",
                    allGenes=all_genes_down,
                    gene2GO=gene2GO_list,
                    nodeSize=10,
                    annot=annFUN.gene2GO)
  }
    
  # Run elim Fisher for DOWN genes
  res_downtopGO_elim <- NULL
  if(!is.null(topGO_down)){
  res_downtopGO_elim <-
    runTest(topGO_down, algorithm = "elim", statistic = "Fisher")
  }
  
  # Extract as data frame for DOWN genes
  res_downtopGO <- NULL
  if(!is.null(res_downtopGO_elim)){
  res_downtopGO <- GenTable(topGO_down, Fisher.elim = res_downtopGO_elim,
        orderBy = "Fisher.elim", topNodes = length(score(res_downtopGO_elim)))
  }

  # Convert p-values for DOWN genes
  if(!is.null(res_downtopGO)){
  res_downtopGO$Fisher.elim <- as.numeric(res_downtopGO$Fisher.elim)
  }
  
  # Remove NAs in Fisher.elim column
  if(!is.null(res_downtopGO)){
  res_downtopGO <- res_downtopGO[!is.na(res_downtopGO$Fisher.elim), ]
  }

  # Condition in case topGO was performed but no terms found
  if(is.null(res_downtopGO) || nrow(as.data.frame(res_downtopGO)) == 0){
      message("No topGO enrichment for DOWN in ", comp_name)
      skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "DOWN: No enrichment")
    } else {
      res_downtopGO$Direction <- "DOWN"   # Add direction for DOWN genes
      results_list[["DOWN"]] <- res_downtopGO   # Store results as DOWN genes
    }
  
  # If no results were produced at all
  if(length(results_list) == 0){
    return(list(
      result = NULL,
      summary = summary_table_GO,
      skipped = TRUE,
      reason = paste(skip_messages, collapse = " | ")
    ))
    }
  
  # Capture number of GO terms obtained after analysis
  n_UP_GO_terms   <- if(!is.null(res_uptopGO)) nrow(res_uptopGO) else 0
  n_DOWN_GO_terms <- if(!is.null(res_downtopGO)) nrow(res_downtopGO) else 0

  # Update CSV with GO results
  summary_table_GO$GO_terms[summary_table_GO$Direction=="UP"] <- n_UP_GO_terms
  summary_table_GO$GO_terms[summary_table_GO$Direction=="DOWN"] <- n_DOWN_GO_terms
  
  # Capture significant GO terms obtained after analysis
  n_UP_GO_sig <- if(!is.null(res_uptopGO))
    sum(res_uptopGO$Fisher.elim < 0.05) else 0

  n_DOWN_GO_sig <- if(!is.null(res_downtopGO))
    sum(res_downtopGO$Fisher.elim < 0.05) else 0
  
  # Update CSV with significant GO results
  summary_table_GO$GO_signif[summary_table_GO$Direction=="UP"] <- n_UP_GO_sig
  summary_table_GO$GO_signif[summary_table_GO$Direction=="DOWN"] <- n_DOWN_GO_sig
  
  # Extract GO -> probes mappings from topGO objects
  GO2probe_up <- NULL
  if(!is.null(topGO_up)){
  GO2probe_up   <- genesInTerm(topGO_up)
  }
  
  GO2probe_down <- NULL
  if(!is.null(topGO_down)){
  GO2probe_down <- genesInTerm(topGO_down)
  }
  
  # Function to extract probes per GO term
  extract_probes <- function(go_ids, GO2probe, DEG_list){
    sapply(go_ids, function(go){
      probes <- GO2probe[[go]]
    
      # If GO term not found return NA
      if(is.null(probes)) return(NA)
    
      # Keep only DE genes belonging to the term
      probes <- probes[probes %in% DEG_list]
      if(length(probes) == 0) return(NA)
      paste(probes, collapse = ",")
    })
  }

  # Apply function to get probe list for UP results
  if("UP" %in% names(results_list)){
    res_uptopGO$Probes <- extract_probes(
      res_uptopGO$GO.ID,
      GO2probe_up,
      UP_genes
    )
      results_list[["UP"]] <- res_uptopGO

  }

  # Apply function to get probe list for DOWN results
  if("DOWN" %in% names(results_list)){
    res_downtopGO$Probes <- extract_probes(
      res_downtopGO$GO.ID,
      GO2probe_down,
      DOWN_genes
    )
      results_list[["DOWN"]] <- res_downtopGO

  }
  
  
  # Combine UP + DOWN
  go_all <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
  
  # Safety check in case no probes exist
    if(!"Probes" %in% colnames(go_all)){
    go_all$Probes <- NA
  }
  
  
  # Function to convert probe lists into gene names
  convert_probes_to_genes <- function(probe_string, mapping){
    if(is.na(probe_string)) return(NA_character_)
    probes <- unlist(strsplit(probe_string, ","))
    genes <- mapping[probes]
    genes <- unique(genes)
    genes <- genes[!is.na(genes)]
    if(length(genes) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    paste(genes, collapse = ",")
  }

  # Convert probes to gene symbols
  go_all$GeneSymbols <- sapply(go_all$Probes,
                             convert_probes_to_genes,
                             probe2gene)
  
  # Column to character
  go_all$GeneSymbols <- as.character(go_all$GeneSymbols)
  
  # Capture symbols from GO results
  n_UP_symbol <- length(unique(
    na.omit(unlist(strsplit(
      go_all$GeneSymbols[go_all$Direction == "UP"], ","
    )))
  ))

  n_DOWN_symbol <- length(unique(
    na.omit(unlist(strsplit(
      go_all$GeneSymbols[go_all$Direction == "DOWN"], ","
    )))
  ))

  
  # Update summary table with Symbols for probes in GO results
  summary_table_GO$SYMBOLs_from_GOterms[summary_table_GO$Direction=="UP"] <- n_UP_symbol
  summary_table_GO$SYMBOLs_from_GOterms[summary_table_GO$Direction=="DOWN"] <- n_DOWN_symbol
  
  # Compute -log10Pvalue for graph
  go_all$logPvalue <- -log10(go_all$Fisher.elim)

  
  # Separate significant GO terms
  go_sig <- go_all[go_all$Fisher.elim < 0.05, ]

  # Count symbols from significant GO terms
  n_UP_symbol_sig <- length(unique(
    na.omit(unlist(strsplit(
      go_sig$GeneSymbols[go_sig$Direction == "UP"], ","
    )))
  ))

  n_DOWN_symbol_sig <- length(unique(
    na.omit(unlist(strsplit(
      go_sig$GeneSymbols[go_sig$Direction == "DOWN"], ","
    )))
  ))

  # Update summary table with Symbols for probes in GO results
  summary_table_GO$SYMBOLs_from_signifGO[summary_table_GO$Direction=="UP"] <- n_UP_symbol_sig
  summary_table_GO$SYMBOLs_from_signifGO[summary_table_GO$Direction=="DOWN"] <- n_DOWN_symbol_sig
  
  
  # Save GO results in CSV
  write.csv(go_all,
            file = paste0("topGO_UP_DOWN_", comp_name, ".csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  
  
  # Filter only for plotting (Top 15 per group)
  go_plot <- go_all %>%
  group_by(Direction) %>%
  filter(Fisher.elim < 0.05) %>%        # keep only significant terms
  arrange(Fisher.elim, .by_group = TRUE) %>%  # order by smallest p-value
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%                # keep max 15 per group
  ungroup()

  
  # Make sure GO terms are factors to control the order in the plot
  go_plot$Term <- factor(go_plot$Term,
                        levels = rev(unique(go_plot$Term)))

  # Safety check for no significant GO 
  if(nrow(go_plot) == 0){
   message("No significant GO terms (Pvalue<0.05) in ", comp_name)
   skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "No significant GO terms")

  # Do NOT return — just skip plotting
  } else {
  
  # Save TIFF
  tiff(paste0("GO_UP_DOWN_", comp_name, ".tiff"),
       width=17, height=12, units="in", res=600)

  print(
    ggplot(go_plot, aes(x = logPvalue,
                       y = Term,
                       color = Direction,
                       size = Significant)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
      facet_wrap(~Direction, scales = "free_y") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("DOWN"="steelblue3",
                                    "UP"="firebrick3")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 10), breaks = sort(unique(go_plot$Significant))) +  # adjust bubble sizes and only signif.numbers in legend
      labs(
        x = "-log10(p-value)",
        y = "GO Term",
        size = "Gene Count",
        color = "Direction"
      ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15), #bigger axis letters
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14), #bigger axis numbers
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18), #bold axis labels
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),  # facet labels
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),   # bold legend titles
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
    )
  )

  dev.off()
  }

  return(list(
    result = go_all,
    summary = summary_table_GO,
    skipped = FALSE,
    reason = ifelse(length(skip_messages) > 0,
                    paste(skip_messages, collapse = " | "),
                    NA)
  ))
}


# Create a list with stored results
topGO_results_all <- list()

# Loop over ALL tissues and comparisons
for(tissue in names(tables)) {
  for(comp in names(tables[[tissue]])) {
    table_current <- tables[[tissue]][[comp]]

    result <- run_topGO_pipeline(
      table = table_current,
      comp_name = paste(tissue, comp, sep="_"),
      tissue_name = tissue,
      backgrounds = backgrounds,
      db_object = salmontranscriptcluster.db
    )

    topGO_results_all[[paste(tissue, comp, sep="_")]] <- result
  }
}

# AFTER loop → create debug table
topGO_log <- data.frame(
  comparison = names(topGO_results_all),
  skipped = sapply(topGO_results_all, function(x) x$skipped),
  reason  = sapply(topGO_results_all, function(x) x$reason)
)

# Save debug table as CSV
write.csv(topGO_log, "topGO_debug_log.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# AFTER loop → create MASTER summary table
all_summary_GO <- do.call(rbind,
  lapply(topGO_results_all, function(x) x$summary)
)

# Save master summary as CSV
write.csv(all_summary_GO,
            file = "GO_summary_AllComparisons.csv",
            sep = ",",
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = TRUE,  # Always write headers for master
            append = FALSE)    # Fresh file, not appending

```


## KEGG Pathway Analysis - Single comparison
Here we perform the KEGG Pathway analysis to associate DEGs with known paths.
```{r Functional Analysis: KEGG – Single}

## Comparison name
comparison_name_test <- "B8_T1EMvsT2IM"

## Define UP and DOWN gene sets
UP_genes_test   <- rownames(table_b8)[table_b8$logFC >=  2 & table_b8$adj.P.Val < 0.05]
DOWN_genes_test <- rownames(table_b8)[table_b8$logFC <= -2 & table_b8$adj.P.Val < 0.05]

# Capture DEGs to save later in CSV
n_UP_DEG   <- length(UP_genes)
n_DOWN_DEG <- length(DOWN_genes)

# To keep only probes that are actually on the DB
valid_probes <- keys(salmontranscriptcluster.db, "PROBEID")

UP_genes <- intersect(UP_genes, valid_probes)
DOWN_genes <- intersect(DOWN_genes, valid_probes)

# Capture valid probes to save later in CSV
n_UP_valid   <- length(UP_genes)
n_DOWN_valid <- length(DOWN_genes)

# To check if there were no probes on the DB
if(length(UP_genes) == 0){
  message("No UP genes with valid PROBEID")
}

if(length(DOWN_genes) == 0){
  message("No DOWN genes with valid PROBEID")
}

## Map UP genes to ENTREZ IDs
if(length(UP_genes) > 0){

entrez_up <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  salmontranscriptcluster.db,
  keys = UP_genes,
  keytype = "PROBEID",
  columns = "ENTREZID"
)

# Remove NAs and duplicates
  entrez_up <- unique(na.omit(entrez_up$ENTREZID))
  
# Diagnostic: how many genes recovered from probes
  cat("UP : probes =", length(UP_genes),
    "| genes recovered =", length(entrez_up), "\n")

} else {

  message("Skipping UP: no valid PROBEIDs")
  entrez_up <- character(0)

}

## Map DOWN genes to ENTREZ IDs
if(length(DOWN_genes) > 0){
  
entrez_down <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  salmontranscriptcluster.db,
  keys = DOWN_genes,
  keytype = "PROBEID",
  columns = "ENTREZID"
)

# Remove NAs and duplicates
  entrez_down <- unique(na.omit(entrez_down$ENTREZID))

# Diagnostic: how many genes recovered from probes
  cat("DOWN : probes =", length(DOWN_genes),
    "| genes recovered =", length(entrez_down), "\n")
  
} else {

  message("Skipping DOWN: no valid PROBEIDs")
  entrez_down <- character(0)

}

# Capture mapped genes to save later in CSV
n_UP_entrez   <- length(entrez_up)
n_DOWN_entrez <- length(entrez_down)

## Combine all ENTREZ IDs that will be used in enrichment
all_entrez <- unique(c(entrez_up, entrez_down))

# Map ENTREZ → gene symbols
entrez2symbol <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  salmontranscriptcluster.db,
  keys = all_entrez,
  keytype = "ENTREZID",
  columns = "SYMBOL"
)

# Convert to mapping vector
entrez2symbol_map <- setNames(entrez2symbol$SYMBOL,
                              entrez2symbol$ENTREZID)


## Run KEGG enrichment separately for UP and DOWN
kegg_up <- NULL
if(length(entrez_up) > 0){
  
kegg_up <- enrichKEGG(
  gene = entrez_up,
  organism = "sasa",
  universe = brain_bg$entrez,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff = 1
)

} else {
  message("Skipping UP: no ENTREZIDs")
}


kegg_down <- NULL
if(length(entrez_down) > 0){
  
kegg_down <- enrichKEGG(
  gene = entrez_down,
  organism = "sasa",
  universe = brain_bg$entrez,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff = 1
)

} else {
  message("Skipping DOWN: no ENTREZIDs")
}

## Combine UP and DOWN KEGG results
# Create data frame
kegg_up_df <- if(!is.null(kegg_up)) data.frame(kegg_up) else data.frame()
kegg_down_df <- if(!is.null(kegg_down)) data.frame(kegg_down) else data.frame()

# Capture KEGG results to save later in CSV
n_UP_kegg   <- nrow(kegg_up_df)
n_DOWN_kegg <- nrow(kegg_down_df)

# Add direction only when the object has results so the code runs does not stop
kegg_list <- list()

if(nrow(kegg_up_df) > 0){
  kegg_up_df$Direction <- "UP"
  kegg_list[["UP"]] <- kegg_up_df
}

if(nrow(kegg_down_df) > 0){
  kegg_down_df$Direction <- "DOWN"
  kegg_list[["DOWN"]] <- kegg_down_df
}

# If no KEGG results at all
if(length(kegg_list) == 0){
  stop("No KEGG enrichment found for UP or DOWN genes.")
  return(NULL)
}

# Combine
kegg_all <- do.call(rbind, kegg_list)

# Add -log10 for FDR
kegg_all$logFDR <- -log10(kegg_all$p.adjust)

## Convert KEGG gene lists to SYMBOLS
# Function to convert gene lists to SYMBOLS
convert_entrez_to_symbol <- function(entrez_string, mapping){
  entrez <- unlist(strsplit(entrez_string, "/"))
  genes <- mapping[entrez]
  genes <- unique(genes)
  genes <- genes[!is.na(genes)]
  paste(genes, collapse = ",")
}

# Apply to KEGG results
kegg_all$GeneSymbols <- sapply(kegg_all$geneID,
                               convert_entrez_to_symbol,
                               entrez2symbol_map)

# Capture GeneSymbols from KEGG results to save later in CSV
n_UP_symbol <- length(unique(na.omit(unlist(strsplit(
  kegg_all$GeneSymbols[kegg_all$Direction == "UP"], ",")))))
  
n_DOWN_symbol <- length(unique(na.omit(unlist(strsplit(
  kegg_all$GeneSymbols[kegg_all$Direction == "DOWN"], ",")))))

## Capture significant KEGGs per direction to save later  in CSV
n_UP_kegg_sig <- sum(kegg_all$Direction == "UP" & kegg_all$p.adjust < 0.05)
n_DOWN_kegg_sig <- sum(kegg_all$Direction == "DOWN" & kegg_all$p.adjust < 0.05)

## Build summary table for mapping data
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Comparison = rep(comparison_name, 2),
  Direction = c("UP", "DOWN"),
  DEGs = c(n_UP_DEG, n_DOWN_DEG),
  Probes_entering_ENTREZmapping = c(n_UP_valid, n_DOWN_valid),
  Probes_with_mappedENTREZ = c(n_UP_entrez, n_DOWN_entrez),
  KEGG_pathways = c(n_UP_kegg, n_DOWN_kegg),
  SYMBOLs_from_KEGGenrich = c(n_UP_symbol, n_DOWN_symbol),
  KEGG_signif = c(n_UP_kegg_sig, n_DOWN_kegg_sig),
  
  Lost_DEGs = c(n_UP_DEG - n_UP_valid, n_DOWN_DEG - n_DOWN_valid),
  Lost_valid_probes = c(n_UP_valid - n_UP_entrez, n_DOWN_valid - n_DOWN_entrez),
  Lost_ENTREZ = c(n_UP_entrez - n_UP_symbol, n_DOWN_entrez - n_DOWN_symbol),
  Lost_KEGG = c(n_UP_kegg - n_UP_kegg_sig, n_DOWN_kegg - n_DOWN_kegg_sig),
  
  Lost_DEGs_pct = c(round((n_UP_DEG - n_UP_valid) / n_UP_DEG * 100, 2),
                      round((n_DOWN_DEG - n_DOWN_valid) / n_DOWN_DEG * 100, 2)),
  Lost_ENTREZ_pct = c(if(n_UP_entrez > 0)
    round((n_UP_entrez - n_UP_symbol) / n_UP_entrez * 100, 2) else 0,
                      if(n_DOWN_entrez > 0)
    round((n_DOWN_entrez - n_DOWN_symbol) / n_DOWN_entrez * 100, 2) else 0),
  Lost_KEGG_pct = c(if(n_UP_kegg > 0)
    round((n_UP_kegg - n_UP_kegg_sig) / n_UP_kegg * 100, 2) else 0,
                    if(n_DOWN_kegg > 0)
    round((n_DOWN_kegg - n_DOWN_kegg_sig) / n_DOWN_kegg * 100, 2) else 0)
)
  
# Save summary table, per each comparison tested, in a master CSV
write.table(summary_table,
            file = "KEGG_summary_AllComparisons.csv",
            sep = ",",
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = !file.exists("KEGG_summary_AllComparisons.csv"),
            append = TRUE)

## Save KEGG results in CSV
  write.csv(kegg_all,
            file = "KEGG_UP_DOWN.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)
  
## Select top pathways per direction
  kegg_plot <- kegg_all %>% 
    group_by(Direction) %>% 
    filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%  # keep only significant paths
    arrange(p.adjust, .by_group = TRUE) %>% 
    slice_head(n = 15) %>% # keep max 15 per group
    ungroup()

## Faceted KEGG UP/DOWN dotplot
if(nrow(kegg_plot) > 0){
  
  p <- ggplot(kegg_plot, aes(x = logFDR,
                     y = reorder(Description, logFDR),
                     color = Direction,
                     size = Count)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Direction, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("DOWN"="steelblue3", "UP"="firebrick3")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 10)) +
  labs(
    x = "-log10(FDR)",
    y = "KEGG pathway",
    size = "Gene Count",
    color = "Direction"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 14)
  )

tiff("KEGG_UP_DOWN_dotplot.tiff", width = 17, height = 12, units = "in", res = 600)

print(p)

dev.off()
} else {

  message("No significant KEGG pathways to plot")

}
```

## KEGG Pathway Analysis - Loop over all comparisons
Here we repeat the KEGG analysis in a loop that processes all comparisons.
```{r Functional Analysis: KEGG – Loop}

## Build ENTREZ → SYMBOL mapping once
entrez_symbol_table <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  salmontranscriptcluster.db,
  keys = keys(salmontranscriptcluster.db, keytype = "ENTREZID"),
  keytype = "ENTREZID",
  columns = "SYMBOL"
)

# Convert to named vector for fast lookup
entrez2symbol_map <- setNames(
  entrez_symbol_table$SYMBOL,
  entrez_symbol_table$ENTREZID
)

## Load tissue-specific backgrounds
load("tissue_backgrounds_27mar.RData")
#brain_bg, gonad_bg, liver_bg

## Create a reusable KEGG function
run_KEGG_pipeline <- function(table, comp_name, tissue_name, db_object,
                              entrez2symbol_map) {

  cat("Running KEGG for:", comp_name, "in", tissue_name,"\n")

  # To save skip messages
  skip_messages <- c()
  
  # To save results
  results_list <- list()
  
  ## Select tissue-specific background
  if(tissue_name == "B") {
    background_entrez <- brain_bg$entrez
  } else if(tissue_name == "G") {
    background_entrez <- gonad_bg$entrez
  } else if(tissue_name == "L") {
    background_entrez <- liver_bg$entrez
  } else {
    stop("Unknown tissue: ", tissue_name)
  }
  
  # To print background size
  cat("  Background size:", length(background_entrez), "genes\n")
  
  # To save mapping data
  summary_stats <- data.frame(
    Comparison = comp_name,
    Tissue = tissue_name,
    Direction = c("UP","DOWN"),

    Universe_size = length(background_entrez),

    DEGs = 0,
    
    Probes_entering_ENTREZmapping = 0,
    Genes_with_mappedENTREZ = 0,
    KEGG_pathways = 0,
    SYMBOLs_from_KEGGenrich = 0,
    KEGG_significant = 0
   )
  
  ## Define UP / DOWN
  UP_genes   <- rownames(table)[table$logFC >=  2 & table$adj.P.Val < 0.05]
  DOWN_genes <- rownames(table)[table$logFC <= -2 & table$adj.P.Val < 0.05]

  # Create a list with both objects for an easier and more structured analysis
  directions <- list(
    UP   = UP_genes,
    DOWN = DOWN_genes
  )

  # For each direction do this - loop for directions:
  for(direction in names(directions)) {
    genes_current <- directions[[direction]]
    
    # Define "idx" to later update summary stats easier
    idx <- which(summary_stats$Direction == direction)
    
    # Capture final number of DEG genes/probes
    n_DEG <- length(genes_current)
    
    # Update DEGs in summary stats
    summary_stats$DEGs[idx] <- n_DEG
    
  
  ## Safety check for when no DEGs exist for a particular direction
  if(n_DEG == 0){
    message("No DEGs for ", direction, " in ", comp_name)
    skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, paste(direction, "No DEGs"))
    next
  }

  # Keep only valid probeIDs
  valid_probes <- keys(db_object, keytype = "PROBEID")
  genes_current <- intersect(genes_current, valid_probes)
  
  # Capture final number of valid PROBEIDs 
  n_valid <- length(genes_current)
  
  # Update valid probes in summary stats
  summary_stats$Probes_entering_ENTREZmapping[idx] <- n_valid
  
  # Safety check for valid PROBEIDs
  if(length(genes_current) == 0){
  message("No valid PROBEIDs for ", direction, " in ", comp_name)
  skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, paste(direction, "No valid PROBEIDs"))
  next
  }
  
  # Diagnostic output
  cat("  ", direction, ": DEGs =", n_DEG, "| valid probes =", n_valid, "\n")

  ## Map PROBE → ENTREZ
    entrez_ids <- AnnotationDbi::select(
      db_object,
      keys = genes_current,
      keytype = "PROBEID",
      column = "ENTREZID"
    )
    
    # Remove NAs and duplicates
    entrez_ids <- unique(na.omit(entrez_ids$ENTREZID))
    
    # Capture ENTREZ count
    n_entrez <- length(entrez_ids)
    
    # Update ENTREZ count in summary stats
    summary_stats$Genes_with_mappedENTREZ[idx] <- n_entrez
  
    # Safety check
    if(n_entrez == 0){
      message("No ENTREZ IDs mapped for ", direction, " in ", comp_name)
      skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, paste(direction, "No ENTREZ IDs"))
      next
    }
    
    cat("    Mapped to", n_entrez, "ENTREZ IDs\n")
    
  ## Run KEGG
    kegg_res <- enrichKEGG(
      gene = entrez_ids,
      organism = "sasa",
      universe = background_entrez,
      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      qvalueCutoff = 1
    )

    # Skip if no enrichment
    if(is.null(kegg_res) || nrow(as.data.frame(kegg_res)) == 0) {
    message("No KEGG enrichment for ", direction," in ", comp_name)
    skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, paste(direction, ":",
                                            "No KEGG enrichment"))
      next
    }

    # Create data frame with KEGG results
    kegg_df <- data.frame(kegg_res)

    # Capture final number of KEGG paths and significant KEGG paths
    n_kegg <- nrow(kegg_df)
    n_kegg_sig <- sum(kegg_df$p.adjust < 0.05)
    
    # Update number of KEGG paths and significant KEGG paths in summary stats
    summary_stats$KEGG_pathways[idx] <- n_kegg
    summary_stats$KEGG_significant[idx] <- n_kegg_sig
    
    # Add direction and -log10 for FDR
    kegg_df$Direction <- direction
    kegg_df$logFDR <- -log10(kegg_df$p.adjust)

    ## Function to convert KEGG gene lists to SYMBOLS
    convert_entrez_to_symbol <- function(entrez_string){
      entrez <- unlist(strsplit(entrez_string,"/"))
      genes <- entrez2symbol_map[entrez]
      genes <- unique(genes)
      genes <- genes[!is.na(genes)]
      paste(genes, collapse = ",")
    }

    # Apply to KEGG results
    kegg_df$GeneSymbols <- sapply(kegg_df$geneID, convert_entrez_to_symbol)
    
    results_list[[direction]] <- kegg_df
    
    ## Count SYMBOLs appearing in KEGG results
    kegg_symbols <- unique(unlist(strsplit(kegg_df$GeneSymbols, ",")))

    kegg_symbols <- kegg_symbols[kegg_symbols != ""]
    n_symbols <- length(kegg_symbols)

    # Update SYMBOLs from KEGG results in summary stats
    summary_stats$SYMBOLs_from_KEGGenrich[idx] <- n_symbols

  }

  ## If nothing ran, skip safely
  if(length(results_list) == 0) {
    return(list(
      result = NULL,
      summary = summary_stats,
      skipped = TRUE,
      reason = paste(skip_messages, collapse = " | ")
   ))
  }

  ## Combine UP and DOWN results
  kegg_all <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
  
  ## Save individual KEGG results (with gene list) CSV (per comparison)
  write.csv(kegg_all,
            file = paste0("KEGG_UP_DOWN_", comp_name, ".csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)

  ## Create plotting dataset
  kegg_plot <- kegg_all %>% 
    group_by(Direction) %>%
    filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = 15) %>% 
    ungroup()

  ## Create and save TIFF
  if(nrow(kegg_plot)>0){

  tiff(paste0("KEGG_UP_DOWN_", comp_name, ".tiff"),
       width = 17, height = 12,
       units = "in", res = 600)

  print(
    ggplot(kegg_plot, aes(x = logFDR,
                         y = reorder(Description, logFDR),
                         color = Direction,
                         size = Count)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
      facet_wrap(~Direction, scales = "free_y") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("DOWN"="steelblue3",
                                    "UP"="firebrick3")) +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 10)) +
      labs(
        x = "-log10(FDR)",
        y = "KEGG pathway",
        size = "Gene Count",
        color = "Direction"
      ) +
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 14)
      )
  )

  dev.off()
}  

return(list(
  result = kegg_all,
  summary = summary_stats,
  skipped = FALSE,
  reason = ifelse(length(skip_messages) > 0,
                  paste(skip_messages, collapse = " | "),
                  NA)
))
}


# Create a list with stored results
KEGG_results_all <- list()

# Loop over ALL tissues and comparisons
# Assumes 'tables' is structured as: tables$Tissue$Comparison
for(tissue in names(tables)) {
  for(comp in names(tables[[tissue]])) {
    table_current <- tables[[tissue]][[comp]]

    result <- run_KEGG_pipeline(
      table = table_current,
      comp_name = paste(tissue,comp,sep="_"),
      tissue_name = tissue,  
      db_object = salmontranscriptcluster.db,
      entrez2symbol_map = entrez2symbol_map
    )

    KEGG_results_all[[paste(tissue, comp, sep="_")]] <- result
  }
}

## AFTER loop → create debug table
kegg_log <- data.frame(
  comparison = names(KEGG_results_all),
  skipped = sapply(KEGG_results_all, function(x) x$skipped),
  reason  = sapply(KEGG_results_all, function(x) x$reason)
)

# Save debug table as CSV
write.csv(kegg_log, "KEGG_debug_log.csv", row.names = FALSE)

## AFTER loop  → create MASTER summary table
all_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(KEGG_results_all, function(x) x$summary))

# Save master summary as CSV
write.csv(all_summary,
            file = "KEGG_summary_AllComparisons.csv",
            sep = ",",
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = TRUE,  # Always write headers for master
            append = FALSE)    # Fresh file, not appending

cat("Completed KEGG analysis for", length(KEGG_results_all), "comparisons\n")
cat("Master summary saved to: KEGG_summary_AllComparisons.csv\n")

```


# Volcano Plot Part 2: Highlight DEG, GO and KEGG in Plot - Single comparison
This second part of the volcano plotting produces a plot which highlights the
DEGs, as well as the DEGs with a significant GO and/or KEGG association. As a
result we get both a plot and a ".csv" file with the list of DEGs that satisfied
the criteria, for each analyzed comparison.

For easy handling of data we recreate the "tab" object here, similarly to the
way it was created in the chunk of the first part of the volcano plot.
```{r Volcano Plot.p2: Highlights in plot - Single}

# SELECT ONE COMPARISON TO TEST
tissue_test <- "G"   # "B", "L", or "G"
comp_test   <- "G_T2_IMvsEM"  # must match your tables list

table_test <- tables[[tissue_test]][[comp_test]]

## Print which comparison is being tested
cat("Running Volcano for:", comp_test, "in", tissue_test, "\n")

## Store skip messages
skip_messages <- c()

## 2. Define and classify DEGs
tab <- table_test

tab$diffexpressed <- "NO"
tab$diffexpressed[tab$logFC >=  2 & tab$adj.P.Val < 0.05] <- "UP"
tab$diffexpressed[tab$logFC <= -2 & tab$adj.P.Val < 0.05] <- "DOWN"

## 6. LOAD DEGs AND SIGNIFICANT GO/KEGG GENES
# DEG file
file_deg  <- paste0("DEG_", tissue_test, "_", comp_test, ".csv")

# Safety check
if(!file.exists(file_deg)){
  skip_messages <- c(skip_messages,"Missing DEG file")}

if(file.exists(file_deg)){
  deg <- read.csv(file_deg)
  deg_clean <- deg[!is.na(deg$SYMBOL), ]
  # Order data
  deg_clean <- deg_clean[
    order(
      deg_clean$diffexpressed, # Order alphabetically
      deg_clean$adj.P.Val,     # Then: smallest FDR first
      -abs(deg_clean$logFC)),]    # Then: largest effect size first
    cat("DEGs loaded:", length(file_deg), "\n")
} else {
  deg_clean <- character(0)
}

# GO file
file_go <- paste0("topGO_UP_DOWN_", tissue_test, "_", comp_test, ".csv")

# Safety check
if(file.exists(file_go)){
  go <- read.csv(file_go)
  go_sig <- go[go$Fisher.elim < 0.05, ]

if(nrow(go_sig) == 0){
  skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "No significant GO terms")
  go_genes <- character(0)
} else {
  go_genes <- trimws(na.omit(unlist(strsplit(go_sig$GeneSymbols, ","))))
    cat("GO genes loaded:", length(go_genes), "\n")
}
  }

# KEGG file
file_kegg <- paste0("KEGG_UP_DOWN_", tissue_test, "_", comp_test, ".csv")

if(file.exists(file_kegg)){
  kegg <- read.csv(file_kegg)
  kegg_genes <- trimws(na.omit(unlist(strsplit(kegg$GeneSymbols, ","))))
    cat("KEGG genes loaded:", length(kegg_genes), "\n")
} else {
  kegg_genes <- character(0)
}

cat("GO genes before highlighting:", length(go_genes), "\n")
cat("KEGG genes before highlighting:", length(kegg_genes), "\n")

## 7. HIGHLIGHT CATEGORIES
tab$Highlight <- "None"

tab$Highlight[tab$SYMBOL %in% go_genes] <- "GO"

tab$Highlight[tab$SYMBOL %in% kegg_genes] <- "KEGG"

tab$Highlight[tab$SYMBOL %in% intersect(go_genes, kegg_genes)] <- "GO+KEGG"

## 8. Labels (top 10 UP / DOWN)
# Extract top symbols directly from ordered clean table
top_up_symbols <- deg_clean$SYMBOL[
  deg_clean$diffexpressed == "UP"
][1:min(10, sum(deg_clean$diffexpressed == "UP"))]

top_down_symbols <- deg_clean$SYMBOL[
  deg_clean$diffexpressed == "DOWN"
][1:min(10, sum(deg_clean$diffexpressed == "DOWN"))]

# Combine
top_symbols <- unique(c(top_up_symbols, top_down_symbols))

# Assign labels and avoid NAs
tab$delabel <- ifelse(tab$SYMBOL %in% top_symbols, tab$SYMBOL, NA)

# Create highlighted subset from the top10 labeled symbols
highlighted_genes <- tab[tab$Highlight != "None" & !is.na(tab$delabel),]

## Safety check — no SYMBOLs
if(all(is.na(tab$delabel))){
  skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "No symbols for labeling")
}

## 9. Volcano plot
tiff(paste0("3JulVolcano_", tissue_test, "_", comp_test, ".tiff"),
     width = 3000, height = 3000, res = 300)

p <- ggplot(
  tab,
  aes(x = logFC,
      y = -log10(adj.P.Val),
      col = diffexpressed,
      label = delabel)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = highlighted_genes, inherit.aes = FALSE,
  aes(
    x = logFC,
    y = -log10(adj.P.Val),
    shape = Highlight), size = 4, stroke = 1.2, color = "black") +
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = Inf) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("DOWN"="#00AFBB","NO"="grey","UP"="firebrick3"), labels = c("Down regulated","Not significant","Up regulated")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("GO" = 17,"KEGG" = 15,"GO+KEGG" = 8)) +
  labs(
    x = expression("log"[2]*"FC"),
    y = expression("-log"[10]*"FDR"),
    color = "Gene expression", shape =  "Functional Annotation") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p)
dev.off()

## 8. Save debug
# Create debug table
volcano_log_single <- data.frame(
  comparison = paste(tissue_test, comp_test, sep="_"),
  skipped = length(skip_messages) > 0,
  reason = ifelse(length(skip_messages) > 0,
                  paste(skip_messages, collapse = " | "),
                  NA)
)

# Save debug CSV
write.csv(volcano_log_single,
          file = "3JulVolcano_debug_singleV2.csv",
            sep = ",",
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = !file.exists("3JulVolcano_debug_singleV2.csv"),
            append = TRUE)

```


# Volcano Plot Part 2: Highlight DEG/GO/KEGG in Plot - Loop over all comparisons
Here we repeat the volcano plotting in a loop that processes all comparisons.
```{r Volcano Plot.p2: Highlights in plot - Loop}

# A reusable volcano-plot function
make_volcano <- function(tab, comparison_name, tissue, backgrounds, db_object) {
    
    # Print to see which comparison is being processed
    cat("Running Volcano for:", comparison_name, "in", tissue, "\n")
  
    # Store skip messages
    skip_messages <- c()
    
    ## 2. Define and classify DEGs
    tab$diffexpressed <- "NO"
    tab$diffexpressed[tab$logFC >=  2 & tab$adj.P.Val < 0.05] <- "UP"
    tab$diffexpressed[tab$logFC <= -2 & tab$adj.P.Val < 0.05] <- "DOWN"
    
    ## 6. LOAD DEGs AND SIGNIFICANT GO/KEGG GENES
    # DEG file
    file_deg  <- paste0("DEG_", comparison_name, ".csv")

    # Safety check
    if(!file.exists(file_deg)){
      skip_messages <- c(skip_messages,"Missing DEG file")
      return(list(
        skipped = TRUE,
        reason = "Missing DEG file"))
      }
    
    if(file.exists(file_deg)){
      deg <- read.csv(file_deg)
      deg_clean <- deg[!is.na(deg$SYMBOL), ]
      # Order data
      deg_clean <- deg_clean[
        order(
         deg_clean$diffexpressed, # Order alphabetically
          deg_clean$adj.P.Val,     # Then: smallest FDR first
          -abs(deg_clean$logFC)),]    # Then: largest effect size first
        cat("DEGs loaded:", nrow(deg_clean), "\n")
    } else {
     deg_clean <- character(0)
    }
    
    # GO file
    file_go <- paste0("topGO_UP_DOWN_", comparison_name, ".csv")

    if(file.exists(file_go)){
      go <- read.csv(file_go)
      go_sig <- go[go$Fisher.elim < 0.05, ]
  
      ## Safety check
      if(nrow(go_sig) == 0){
        skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "No significant GO terms")
      go_genes <- character(0)
      } else {
      go_genes <- trimws(na.omit(unlist(strsplit(go_sig$GeneSymbols, ","))))
        cat("GO genes loaded:", length(go_genes), "\n")
    }
    }

    # KEGG file
    file_kegg <- paste0("KEGG_UP_DOWN_", comparison_name, ".csv")

   if(file.exists(file_kegg)){
    kegg <- read.csv(file_kegg)
    kegg_genes <- trimws(na.omit(unlist(strsplit(kegg$GeneSymbols, ","))))
      cat("KEGG genes loaded:", length(kegg_genes), "\n")
    } else {
      kegg_genes <- character(0)
    }

    cat("GO genes before highlighting:", length(go_genes), "\n")
    cat("KEGG genes before highlighting:", length(kegg_genes), "\n")

    ## 7. HIGHLIGHT CATEGORIES
    tab$Highlight <- "None"

    tab$Highlight[tab$SYMBOL %in% go_genes] <- "GO"

    tab$Highlight[tab$SYMBOL %in% kegg_genes] <- "KEGG"

    tab$Highlight[tab$SYMBOL %in% intersect(go_genes, kegg_genes)] <- "GO+KEGG"


    ## 8. Labels (top 10 per direction UP/DOWN)
    # Extract top 10 symbols directly from ordered clean table
    top_up_symbols <- deg_clean$SYMBOL[
      deg_clean$diffexpressed == "UP"
    ][1:min(10, sum(deg_clean$diffexpressed == "UP"))]

    top_down_symbols <- deg_clean$SYMBOL[
      deg_clean$diffexpressed == "DOWN"
    ][1:min(10, sum(deg_clean$diffexpressed == "DOWN"))]

    # Combine
    top_symbols <- unique(c(top_up_symbols, top_down_symbols))
    
    # Assign labels and avoid NAs
    tab$delabel <- ifelse(tab$SYMBOL %in% top_symbols, tab$SYMBOL, NA)
    
    # Create highlighted subset from the top10 labeled symbols
    highlighted_genes <- tab[tab$Highlight != "None" & !is.na(tab$delabel),]

  
    ## Safety check — no SYMBOLs
    if(all(is.na(tab$delabel))){
      skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "No symbols for labeling")
      return(list(
        skipped = TRUE,
        reason = "No symbols for labeling"
      ))
      }

    
    ## 9. Volcano plot
    tiff(paste0("Volcano_", comparison_name, ".tiff"),
         width = 3000, height = 3000, res = 300)

    p <- ggplot(
      tab,
      aes(x = logFC,
          y = -log10(adj.P.Val),
          col = diffexpressed,
          label = delabel)
    ) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_point(data = highlighted_genes, inherit.aes = FALSE,
      aes(
        x = logFC,
        y = -log10(adj.P.Val),
        shape = Highlight), size = 4, stroke = 1.2, color = "black") + 
      geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = Inf) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("DOWN"="#00AFBB", "NO"="grey", "UP"="firebrick3"), labels = c("Down regulated","Not significant","Up regulated")) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c("GO" = 17,"KEGG" = 15,"GO+KEGG" = 8)) +
      labs(
        x = expression("log"[2]*"FC"),
        y = expression("-log"[10]*"FDR"),
        color = "Gene expression",
        shape =  "Functional Annotation") +
      theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
      theme(
       axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

   print(p)
   dev.off()

    return(list(
      skipped = FALSE,
      reason = ifelse(length(skip_messages)>0,
                      paste(skip_messages, collapse=" | "),
                      NA)
    ))
}


## Loop over ALL tissues and all comparisons
volcano_results_all <- list()

for (tissue in names(tables)) {
  for (comp in names(tables[[tissue]])) {

    result <- make_volcano(
      tab = tables[[tissue]][[comp]],
      comparison_name = paste(tissue, comp, sep="_"),
      tissue = tissue,
      backgrounds = backgrounds,
      db_object = salmontranscriptcluster.db
    )

    volcano_results_all[[paste(tissue, comp, sep="_")]] <- result
  }
}


## AFTER loop → create debug table
volcano_log <- data.frame(
  comparison = names(volcano_results_all),
  skipped = sapply(volcano_results_all, function(x) x$skipped),
  reason  = sapply(volcano_results_all, function(x) x$reason)
)

# Save debug table as CSV
write.csv(volcano_log, "Volcano_debug_logV2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


# Gene Associations - Gene Overlaps and High-Confidence Genes
Once we defined DEGs and performed the functional analysis we have sufficient
annotation information about our DEGs to use it to find genes that overlap
between our DEG, GO and KEGG analysis results, aiming to find "High-Confidence"
or well annotated genes, which we can more confidently associated to early
sexual maturation in Atlantic salmon males.

## Gene Overlaps (Volcano vs GO vs KEGG) - Single comparison
Here we obtain a ".csv" file with both the UP and DOWN regulated DEGs, and it
indicates which of those DEGs also have a significant GO and/or KEGG annotation.
```{r Gene Associations: Gene Overlaps - Single}

## SELECT ONE COMPARISON
tissue_test <- "G"
comp_test   <- "G_T2_IMvsEM"

comp_name <- paste(tissue_test, comp_test, sep = "_")

# To print which comparison is being tested
cat("Checking:", comp_name, "\n")

## Store messages
skip_messages <- c()

## File names
file_deg  <- paste0("DEG_", comp_name, ".csv")
file_go   <- paste0("topGO_UP_DOWN_", comp_name, ".csv")
file_kegg <- paste0("KEGG_UP_DOWN_", comp_name, ".csv")


## 1. LOAD FILES, EXTRACT AND SPLIT DATA BY DIRECTION
## DEG (Volcano)
if(!file.exists(file_deg)){
  skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "Missing DEG file")
  message("Missing DEG file")
  deg_up_genes <- character(0)
  deg_down_genes <- character(0)
} else {
  deg <- read.csv(file_deg)
    
  # Inspect
  cat("DEG rows:", nrow(deg), "\n")

if(any(deg$diffexpressed == "UP")){
  deg_up_genes <- unique(na.omit(deg$SYMBOL[deg$diffexpressed == "UP"]))
  } 
  
if(any(deg$diffexpressed == "DOWN")){
  deg_down_genes <- unique(na.omit(deg$SYMBOL[deg$diffexpressed == "DOWN"]))
  }
  
cat("UP DEGs:", length(deg_up_genes), "\n")
cat("DOWN DEGs:", length(deg_down_genes), "\n")
}

## GO
if(!file.exists(file_go)){
  skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "Missing GO file")
  message("Missing GO file")
  go_up_genes <- character(0)
  go_down_genes <- character(0)
} else {
  go <- read.csv(file_go)
  
  # KEEP ONLY SIGNIFICANT GO TERMS
  go_sig <- go[go$Fisher.elim < 0.05, ]
  
  cat("GO rows:", nrow(go), "\n")
  
  # Safety check
  if(nrow(go_sig) == 0){
    skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "No significant GO terms")
    go_up_genes <- character(0)
    go_down_genes <- character(0)
  } else {
  
  # Split comma-separated symbols
  if(any(go_sig$Direction == "UP")){

      na.omit(
        unlist(strsplit(go_sig$GeneSymbols[go_sig$Direction == "UP"], ","))))
    } 
  
  if(any(go_sig$Direction == "DOWN")){
    go_down_genes <- unique(
      na.omit(
        unlist(strsplit(go_sig$GeneSymbols[go_sig$Direction == "DOWN"], ","))))
    }
    
  cat("GO UP genes:", length(go_up_genes), "\n")
  cat("GO DOWN genes:", length(go_down_genes), "\n")
  }
  }

## KEGG
if(!file.exists(file_kegg)){
  skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "Missing KEGG file")
  message("Missing KEGG file")
  kegg_up_genes <- character(0)
  kegg_down_genes <- character(0)
} else {
  kegg <- read.csv(file_kegg)
  
  cat("KEGG rows:", nrow(kegg), "\n")
  
  # Split comma-separated symbols
if(any(kegg$Direction == "UP")){
  kegg_up_genes <- unique(
    na.omit(
      unlist(strsplit(kegg$GeneSymbols[kegg$Direction == "UP"], ","))))
  } 
  
if(any(kegg$Direction == "DOWN")){
  kegg_down_genes <- unique(
    na.omit(
      unlist(strsplit(kegg$GeneSymbols[kegg$Direction == "DOWN"], ","))))
}
  
cat("KEGG UP genes:", length(kegg_up_genes), "\n")
cat("KEGG DOWN genes:", length(kegg_down_genes), "\n")
}


## 2. DIRECTION-SPECIFIC OVERLAPS
## UP overlaps
up_volc_go <- intersect(deg_up_genes, go_up_genes)
up_volc_kegg <- intersect(deg_up_genes, kegg_up_genes)
up_go_kegg <- intersect(go_up_genes, kegg_up_genes)

up_all_three <- Reduce(
  intersect,

    deg_up_genes,

## DOWN overlaps

## 3. SUMMARY TABLE

## 4. SAVE OVERLAP GENE TABLE

  ## UP
```

## Gene Overlaps (Volcano vs GO vs KEGG) - Loop over all comparisons
Here we repeat the analysis in a loop that processes all comparisons.
```{r Gene Associations: Gene Overlaps – Loop}

## Store all results
checker_results_all <- list()

## Loop over ALL tissues and comparisons
for (tissue in names(tables)) {
  for (comp in names(tables[[tissue]])) {
    
    comp_name <- paste(tissue, comp, sep = "_")
    
    cat("\n=============================\n")
    cat("Checking:", comp_name, "\n")
    cat("=============================\n")
    
    ## Store messages
    skip_messages <- c()
    
    ## File names
    file_deg  <- paste0("DEG_", comp_name, ".csv")
    file_go   <- paste0("topGO_UP_DOWN_", comp_name, ".csv")
    file_kegg <- paste0("KEGG_UP_DOWN_", comp_name, ".csv")
    
    ## Safety check — all files missing
    if(
      !file.exists(file_deg) &
      !file.exists(file_go) &
      !file.exists(file_kegg)
    ){
      skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "All files missing")
    }
    
    ## 1. LOAD FILES, EXTRACT AND SPLIT DATA BY DIRECTION
    ## DEG
    if(!file.exists(file_deg)){
      skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "Missing DEG file")
      message("Missing DEG file")
      deg_up_genes <- character(0)
      deg_down_genes <- character(0)
    } else {
      deg <- read.csv(file_deg)
      
      deg_up_genes <- character(0)
      deg_down_genes <- character(0)
    
    if(any(deg$diffexpressed == "UP")){
      deg_up_genes <- unique(na.omit(deg$SYMBOL[deg$diffexpressed == "UP"]))
      } 
    
    if(any(deg$diffexpressed == "DOWN")){
      deg_down_genes <- unique(na.omit(deg$SYMBOL[deg$diffexpressed == "DOWN"]))
      }
    }

    
    ## GO
    if(!file.exists(file_go)){
      skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "Missing GO file")
      message("Missing GO file")
      go_up_genes <- character(0)
      go_down_genes <- character(0)
    } else {
      go <- read.csv(file_go)
      
    # KEEP ONLY SIGNIFICANT GO TERMS
      go_sig <- go[go$Fisher.elim < 0.05, ]
      
    # Safety check
    if(nrow(go_sig) == 0){
      skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "No significant GO terms")
      go_up_genes <- character(0)
      go_down_genes <- character(0)
    } else {
      
      go_up_genes <- character(0)
      go_down_genes <- character(0)

    # Split comma-separated symbols
    if(any(go_sig$Direction == "UP")){
      go_up_genes <- unique(na.omit(
        unlist(strsplit(go_sig$GeneSymbols[go_sig$Direction == "UP"], ","))))
    } 
      
    if(any(go_sig$Direction == "DOWN")){
      go_down_genes <- unique(na.omit(
        unlist(strsplit(go_sig$GeneSymbols[go_sig$Direction == "DOWN"], ","))))
    }
    }
    }
    
    ## KEGG
    if(!file.exists(file_kegg)){
      skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "Missing KEGG file")
      message("Missing KEGG file")
      kegg_up_genes <- character(0)
      kegg_down_genes <- character(0)
    } else {
      kegg <- read.csv(file_kegg)
      
      kegg_up_genes <- character(0)
      kegg_down_genes <- character(0)
      
    # Split comma-separated symbols
    if(any(kegg$Direction == "UP")){
      kegg_up_genes <- unique(na.omit(
        unlist(strsplit(kegg$GeneSymbols[kegg$Direction == "UP"], ","))))
    }
     
    if(any(kegg$Direction == "DOWN")){
      kegg_down_genes <- unique(na.omit(
        unlist(strsplit(kegg$GeneSymbols[kegg$Direction == "DOWN"], ","))))
      }
    }
    
    ## 2. DIRECTION-SPECIFIC OVERLAPS
    ## UP overlaps
    up_volc_go <- intersect(deg_up_genes, go_up_genes)
    up_volc_kegg <- intersect(deg_up_genes, kegg_up_genes)
    up_go_kegg <- intersect(go_up_genes, kegg_up_genes)

    up_all_three <- Reduce(
      intersect,
      list(
        deg_up_genes,
        go_up_genes,
        kegg_up_genes))
    
    ## DOWN overlaps
    down_volc_go <- intersect(deg_down_genes, go_down_genes)
    down_volc_kegg <- intersect(deg_down_genes, kegg_down_genes)
    down_go_kegg <- intersect(go_down_genes, kegg_down_genes)

    down_all_three <- Reduce(
      intersect,
      list(
        deg_down_genes,
        go_down_genes,
        kegg_down_genes))

    
    ## 3. SUMMARY TABLE
    summary_checker <- data.frame(
      Comparison = comp_name,
      Tissue = tissue,
      
      ## UP
      Volcano_UP = length(deg_up_genes),
      GO_UP = length(go_up_genes),
      KEGG_UP = length(kegg_up_genes),
      
      Volcano_GO_UP = length(up_volc_go),
      Volcano_KEGG_UP = length(up_volc_kegg),
      GO_KEGG_UP = length(up_go_kegg),
      All_three_UP = length(up_all_three),

      ## DOWN
      Volcano_DOWN = length(deg_down_genes),
      GO_DOWN = length(go_down_genes),
      KEGG_DOWN = length(kegg_down_genes),
      
      Volcano_GO_DOWN = length(down_volc_go),
      Volcano_KEGG_DOWN = length(down_volc_kegg),
      GO_KEGG_DOWN = length(down_go_kegg),
      All_three_DOWN = length(down_all_three),
      
      skipped = ifelse(length(skip_messages)>0, TRUE, FALSE),
      reason = ifelse(length(skip_messages)>0,
                      paste(skip_messages, collapse=" | "),
                      NA)
    )
    
    
    ## 4. SAVE OVERLAP TABLE
    overlap_list <- list(
      ## UP
      Volcano_UP = deg_up_genes,
      GO_UP = go_up_genes,
      KEGG_UP = kegg_up_genes,
      
      Volcano_GO_UP = up_volc_go,
      Volcano_KEGG_UP = up_volc_kegg,
      GO_KEGG_UP = up_go_kegg,
      All_three_UP = up_all_three,
      
      ## DOWN
      Volcano_DOWN = deg_down_genes,
      GO_DOWN = go_down_genes,
      KEGG_DOWN = kegg_down_genes,
      
      Volcano_GO_DOWN = down_volc_go,
      Volcano_KEGG_DOWN = down_volc_kegg,
      GO_KEGG_DOWN = down_go_kegg,
      All_three_DOWN = down_all_three)
    
    # Make equal-length columns
    max_len <- max(sapply(overlap_list, length))
    
    overlap_df <- as.data.frame(lapply(overlap_list, function(x){
      length(x) <- max_len
      return(x)
    }))
    
    write.csv(overlap_df,
              file = paste0("GeneOverlap_", comp_name, ".csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    ## STORE RESULTS
    checker_results_all[[comp_name]] <- list(
      summary = summary_checker,
      skipped = summary_checker$skipped,
      reason = summary_checker$reason
    )
  }
}
    
    ## AFTER LOOP → MASTER SUMMARY TABLE
    all_summary_checker <- do.call(rbind,
      lapply(checker_results_all, function(x) x$summary))

    # Save CSV
    write.csv(all_summary_checker,
      file = "SummaryChecker_ALL.csv",
      sep = ",",
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = TRUE, # Always write headers for master
      append = FALSE) # Fresh file, not appending

```



## High-Confidence Genes (Volcano vs GO vs KEGG) - Single comparison
Here we obtain two ".csv" files. The first file includes both the UP and DOWN
regulated DEGs, it indicates if those DEGs had also significant GO and/or KEGG
annotation, and in contrast with the Gene Overlap file, this file also includes
statistical data for each DEG, such as FDR, logFC, its p.value for GO,
p.adjusted for KEGG, as well as a column specifying GO terms and KEGG paths
associated with each DEG.
The second file obtained here, which includes the exact same columns as the
first one, only contains the filtered DEGs that have at least another functional
annotation different than that of the gene, either in GO terms or KEGG pathways.
```{r Gene Associations: High-Confidence – Single}

## SELECT COMPARISON
tissue_test <- "G"
comp_test   <- "G_T2_IMvsEM"

comp_name <- paste(tissue_test, comp_test, sep = "_")

# To print which comparison is being tested
cat("Building integrative table for:", comp_name, "\n")

## Store messages
skip_messages <- c()

## File names
file_deg  <- paste0("DEG_", comp_name, ".csv")
file_go   <- paste0("topGO_UP_DOWN_", comp_name, ".csv")
file_kegg <- paste0("KEGG_UP_DOWN_", comp_name, ".csv")

## 1. LOAD DATA
## DEG
if(!file.exists(file_deg)){
  stop(paste("Missing DEG file:", file_deg))
}

deg  <- read.csv(file_deg)

## GO
if(!file.exists(file_go)){
  skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "Missing GO file")
  message("Missing GO file")
  go <- NULL
} else {
  go <- read.csv(file_go)
}


if(!file.exists(file_kegg)){
  skip_messages <- c(skip_messages, "Missing KEGG file")
  message("Missing KEGG file")
  kegg <- NULL
} else {
  kegg <- read.csv(file_kegg)
}


## 2. CLEAN DEG TABLE
# Clean DEG table
deg_clean <- deg[!is.na(deg$SYMBOL) &
  deg$SYMBOL != "", ]

# Keep only relevant columns
deg_clean <- deg_clean[, c("SYMBOL","logFC","adj.P.Val","diffexpressed")]

# Rename for clarity
colnames(deg_clean) <- c("SYMBOL","logFC","FDR","Direction")


## 3. BUILD GO MAPPING
if(is.null(go)){
  go_agg <- data.frame(
    SYMBOL = character(),
    Direction = character(),
    GO_ID = character(),
    GO_Term = character(),
    GO_pvalue = character()
  )
} else {
  
  ## KEEP ONLY SIGNIFICANT TERMS
  go_sig <- go[
    go$Fisher.elim < 0.05,
  ]
  
  cat("Significant GO terms:", nrow(go_sig), "\n")
  
  ## Safety check
  if(nrow(go_sig) == 0){
    skip_messages <- c(
      skip_messages,
      "No significant GO terms")
    
    go_agg <- data.frame(
      SYMBOL = character(),
      Direction = character(),
      GO_ID = character(),
      GO_Term = character(),
      GO_pvalue = character())
  } else {
    
    ## Split GeneSymbols column
    go_sig$GeneList <- strsplit(
      as.character(go_sig$GeneSymbols), ",")
    
    ## Expand GO table
     # Stack all data frames created per each row of GO term
    go_expanded <- do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(
        1:nrow(go_sig),
        function(i){
          
          # To return if there are no results
          if(is.na(go_sig$GeneSymbols[i])){
            return(NULL)
          }
          
          # To remove spaces (trimws) and list structure (unlist)
          genes <- trimws(
            unlist(go_sig$GeneList[i])
          )
          
          # To add data to data frame
          data.frame(
            SYMBOL = genes,
            Direction = go_sig$Direction[i],
            GO_ID = go_sig$GO.ID[i],
            GO_Term = go_sig$Term[i],
            GO_pvalue = go_sig$Fisher.elim[i],
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        }
      )
    )
    
    ## Safety check
    if(is.null(go_expanded) ||
      nrow(go_expanded) == 0){
      
      go_agg <- data.frame(
        SYMBOL = character(),
        Direction = character(),
        GO_ID = character(),
        GO_Term = character(),
        GO_pvalue = character())
    } else {
      
      ## Aggregate per SYMBOL + Direction, avoids duplic.DEG rows, gene per row
      go_agg <- aggregate(
        . ~ SYMBOL + Direction,
        data = go_expanded,
        FUN = function(x){
          paste(unique(x), collapse = ",")
        }
      )
      
      cat("Genes represented in significant GO terms:", nrow(go_agg),"\n")
    }
  }
}



## 4. BUILD KEGG MAPPING
if(is.null(kegg)){
  
  kegg_agg <- data.frame(
    SYMBOL = character(),
    Direction = character(),
    KEGG_ID = character(),
    KEGG_Pathway = character(),
    KEGG_padj = character())
} else {
  
  ## Split GeneSymbols column
  kegg$GeneList <- strsplit(
    as.character(kegg$GeneSymbols), ",")
  
  ## Expand KEGG table
  # Stack all data frames created per each row of KEGG pathway
  kegg_expanded <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(
      1:nrow(kegg),
      function(i){
        
        # To return if there are no results
        if(is.na(kegg$GeneSymbols[i])){
          return(NULL)
        }
        
        # To remove spaces (trimws) and list structure (unlist)
        genes <- trimws(
          unlist(kegg$GeneList[i]))
        
        # To add data to data frame
        data.frame(
          SYMBOL = genes,
          Direction = kegg$Direction[i],
          KEGG_ID = kegg$ID[i],
          KEGG_Pathway = kegg$Description[i],
          KEGG_padj = kegg$p.adjust[i],
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      }
    )
  )

  ## Safety check
  if(is.null(kegg_expanded) ||
    nrow(kegg_expanded) == 0){
    
    kegg_agg <- data.frame(
      SYMBOL = character(),
      Direction = character(),
      KEGG_ID = character(),
      KEGG_Pathway = character(),
      KEGG_padj = character())
  } else {
  
  ## Aggregate per SYMBOL + Direction, avoids duplicated DEG rows, gene per row
    kegg_agg <- aggregate(
      . ~ SYMBOL + Direction,
      data = kegg_expanded,
      FUN = function(x){
        paste(unique(x), collapse = ",")
      }
    )
    
    cat("Genes represented in KEGG pathways:", nrow(kegg_agg),"\n")
  }
}


## 5. MERGE EVERYTHING
## Merge GO
deg_annot <- merge(
  deg_clean,
  go_agg,
  by = c(
    "SYMBOL",
    "Direction"
  ),
  all.x = TRUE)

## Merge KEGG
deg_annot <- merge(
  deg_annot,
  kegg_agg,
  by = c(
    "SYMBOL",
    "Direction"
  ),
  all.x = TRUE)


## 6. ADD COUNTS
deg_annot$N_GO_terms <- ifelse(
  is.na(deg_annot$GO_ID),
  0,
  lengths(
    strsplit(
      deg_annot$GO_ID,
      ",")))

deg_annot$N_KEGG_paths <- ifelse(
  is.na(deg_annot$KEGG_ID),
  0,
  lengths(
    strsplit(
      deg_annot$KEGG_ID,
      ",")))


## 7. ADD FLAGS
deg_annot$In_GO <- !is.na(deg_annot$GO_ID)

deg_annot$In_KEGG <- !is.na(deg_annot$KEGG_ID)

deg_annot$In_GO_KEGG <-
  deg_annot$In_GO &
  deg_annot$In_KEGG

## 7.1. SUPPORT COUNT COLUMN
# All genes in this table are DEGs
deg_annot$Volcano <- TRUE

# Count evidence sources
deg_annot$Support_Count <-
  as.numeric(deg_annot$Volcano) +
  as.numeric(deg_annot$In_GO) +
  as.numeric(deg_annot$In_KEGG)


## 8. ADD METADATA
deg_annot$Tissue <- tissue_test

deg_annot$Comparison <- comp_name

deg_annot$Notes <- ifelse(
  length(skip_messages) > 0,
  paste(skip_messages, collapse = " | "),
  NA
)


## 9. ORDER AND SAVE FULL INTEGRATIVE TABLE
# Order columns
deg_annot <- deg_annot[, c(
  "Tissue",
  "Comparison",
  "SYMBOL",
  "Direction",
  "FDR",
  "logFC",
  "Support_Count",
  "Volcano",
  "In_GO",
  "In_KEGG",
  "GO_ID",
  "GO_Term",
  "GO_pvalue",
  "N_GO_terms",
  "KEGG_ID",
  "KEGG_Pathway",
  "KEGG_padj",
  "N_KEGG_paths",
  "Notes")]

# Order rows 
deg_annot <- deg_annot[
  order(
    deg_annot$Direction,
    deg_annot$FDR,
    -abs(deg_annot$logFC)),]

# Inspect
head(deg_annot)

cat("Final rows:", nrow(deg_annot),"\n")

# Save integrative table as CSV
write.csv(deg_annot,
          file = paste0("Integrative_", comp_name, ".csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)


## 10. FILTER, ORDER AND SAVE HIGH-CONFIDENCE GENES
# Filter by support count
deg_annotHCG <- deg_annot[deg_annot$Support_Count >= 2,]

# Order by smallest FDR first
deg_annotHCG <- deg_annotHCG[
  order(
    deg_annotHCG$Direction,
    deg_annotHCG$FDR,
    -abs(deg_annotHCG$logFC),
    -deg_annotHCG$Support_Count),]

# Inspect
head(deg_annotHCG)

# Save high-confidence genes as CSV
write.csv(deg_annotHCG,
  file = paste0("TopCandidates_", comp_name, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## High-Confidence Genes (Volcano vs GO vs KEGG) - Loop over all comparisons
Here we repeat the analysis in a loop that processes all comparisons.
```{r Gene Associations: High-Confidence – Loop}

## STORE ALL RESULTS
integrative_results_all <- list()

## LOOP OVER ALL COMPARISONS
for (tissue in names(tables)) {
  for (comp in names(tables[[tissue]])) {

    comp_name <- paste(tissue, comp, sep = "_")

    cat("\n=============================\n")
    cat("Building:", comp_name, "\n")
    cat("=============================\n")

    # Store messages
    skip_messages <- c()
    warning_messages <- c()
    
    # File names
    file_deg  <- paste0("DEG_", comp_name, ".csv")
    file_go   <- paste0("topGO_UP_DOWN_", comp_name, ".csv")
    file_kegg <- paste0("KEGG_UP_DOWN_", comp_name, ".csv")
    
    
## Safety check — all files missing
    if(
      !file.exists(file_deg) &
      !file.exists(file_go) &
      !file.exists(file_kegg)
    ){

      skip_messages <- c(
        skip_messages,
        "All files missing"
      )

      integrative_results_all[[comp_name]] <- list(
        summary = data.frame(
          Comparison = comp_name,
          Tissue = tissue,
          DEGs = 0,
          GO_Genes = 0,
          KEGG_Genes = 0,
          GO_KEGG_Genes = 0,
          HighConfidence = 0,
          GO_Terms = 0,
          KEGG_Pathways = 0,
          skipped = TRUE,
          reason = "All files missing",
          warnings = ""
        )
      )

      next
    }
    
    
## 1. LOAD DATA
    ## DEGs
    if(file.exists(file_deg)){
      deg <- read.csv(file_deg)
    }
    
    ## GO
    if(!file.exists(file_go)){
      warning_messages <- c(warning_messages,"Missing GO file")
      go <- NULL
    } else {
      go <- read.csv(file_go)
    }
    
    ## KEGG
    if(!file.exists(file_kegg)){
      warning_messages <- c(warning_messages,"Missing KEGG file")
      kegg <- NULL
    } else {
      kegg <- read.csv(file_kegg)
    }
    
    
## 2. CLEAN DEG TABLE
  # Clean DEG table
  deg_clean <- deg[!is.na(deg$SYMBOL) &
  deg$SYMBOL != "", ]

  # Keep only relevant columns
  deg_clean <- deg_clean[, c("SYMBOL","logFC","adj.P.Val","diffexpressed")]

  # Rename for clarity
  colnames(deg_clean) <- c("SYMBOL","logFC","FDR","Direction")

  # Safety check for no rows
  if(nrow(deg_clean) == 0){
    skip_messages <- c(skip_messages,"No valid symbols after cleaning")
    next
    }

  
## 3. BUILD GO MAPPING
if(is.null(go)){
  go_agg <- data.frame(
    SYMBOL = character(),
    Direction = character(),
    GO_ID = character(),
    GO_Term = character(),
    GO_pvalue = character()
  )
} else {
  
  ## KEEP ONLY SIGNIFICANT TERMS
  go_sig <- go[
    go$Fisher.elim < 0.05,
  ]
  
  cat("Significant GO terms:", nrow(go_sig), "\n")
  
  ## Safety check
  if(nrow(go_sig) == 0){
    warning_messages <- c(
      warning_messages,
      "No significant GO terms")
    
    go_agg <- data.frame(
      SYMBOL = character(),
      Direction = character(),
      GO_ID = character(),
      GO_Term = character(),
      GO_pvalue = character())
  } else {
    
    ## Split GeneSymbols column
    go_sig$GeneList <- strsplit(
      as.character(go_sig$GeneSymbols), ",")
    
    ## Expand GO table
     # Stack all data frames created per each row of GO term
    go_expanded <- do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(
        1:nrow(go_sig),
        function(i){
          
          # To return if there are no results
          if(is.na(go_sig$GeneSymbols[i])){
            return(NULL)
          }
          
          # To remove spaces (trimws) and list structure (unlist)
          genes <- trimws(
            unlist(go_sig$GeneList[i])
          )
          
          # To add data to data frame
          data.frame(
            SYMBOL = genes,
            Direction = go_sig$Direction[i],
            GO_ID = go_sig$GO.ID[i],
            GO_Term = go_sig$Term[i],
            GO_pvalue = go_sig$Fisher.elim[i],
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        }
      )
    )
    
    ## Safety check
    if(is.null(go_expanded) ||
      nrow(go_expanded) == 0){
      
      go_agg <- data.frame(
        SYMBOL = character(),
        Direction = character(),
        GO_ID = character(),
        GO_Term = character(),
        GO_pvalue = character())
    } else {
      
      ## Aggregate per SYMBOL + Direction, avoids duplic.DEG rows, gene per row
      go_agg <- aggregate(
        . ~ SYMBOL + Direction,
        data = go_expanded,
        FUN = function(x){
          paste(unique(x), collapse = ",")
        }
      )
      
      cat("Genes represented in significant GO terms:", nrow(go_agg),"\n")
    }
  }
}

  
  
## 4. BUILD KEGG MAPPING
if(is.null(kegg)){
  
  kegg_agg <- data.frame(
    SYMBOL = character(),
    Direction = character(),
    KEGG_ID = character(),
    KEGG_Pathway = character(),

  kegg_expanded <- do.call(

        if(is.na(kegg$GeneSymbols[i])){

        }

          KEGG_Pathway = kegg$Description[i],
          KEGG_padj = kegg$p.adjust[i],

      }

  ## Safety check
  if(is.null(kegg_expanded) ||
    nrow(kegg_expanded) == 0){
    
    kegg_agg <- data.frame(
      SYMBOL = character(),
      Direction = character(),
      KEGG_ID = character(),
      KEGG_Pathway = character(),
      KEGG_padj = character())
  } else {
  
  ## Aggregate per SYMBOL + Direction, avoids duplicated DEG rows, gene per row
    kegg_agg <- aggregate(
      . ~ SYMBOL + Direction,
      data = kegg_expanded,
      FUN = function(x){

## 5. MERGE EVERYTHING
## Merge GO

## 6. ADD COUNTS

## 7. ADD FLAGS

deg_annot$In_KEGG <- !is.na(deg_annot$KEGG_ID)

deg_annot$In_GO_KEGG <-

## 7.1. SUPPORT COUNT COLUMN
# All genes in this table are DEGs

# Count evidence sources

## 9. ORDER AND SAVE FULL INTEGRATIVE TABLE

deg_annot <- deg_annot[, c(
  "Tissue",

# Order rows

  order(
    deg_annot$Direction,

# Inspect
head(deg_annot)

cat("Final rows:", nrow(deg_annot),"\n")

# Save integrative table as CSV
write.csv(deg_annot,
          file = paste0("Integrative_", comp_name, ".csv"),

## 10. FILTER, ORDER AND SAVE HIGH-CONFIDENCE GENES
# Filter by support count
deg_annotHCG <- deg_annot[deg_annot$Support_Count >= 2,]

# Order by smallest FDR first. It considers only the first,
# then when the rows are similar it considers the next argument.
deg_annotHCG <- deg_annotHCG[
  order(
    deg_annotHCG$Direction,

# Safety check 
    if(nrow(deg_annotHCG) > 0){

    summary_integrative <- data.frame(

  }
}
```
